tab.public.note: Contributions visible to everyone in the last 12 months.
tab.all.note: Public plus private contributions; private ones count only for people who show them on their profile. They cannot be checked, so people with less than {n}% public contributions are left out.

row.automated.quiet: Likely automated: {share}% of commits in one repository of their own with under {stars} stars (limit {limit}%). Not in the world ranking.
badge.title: Get your contributor.top badge
badge.description: Add a badge with your rank among the most active GitHub users in your country to your GitHub profile README.
badge.intro: Show your rank in your GitHub profile README. The badge updates by itself whenever your country is updated.
badge.explain: One badge per ranking: public contributions, all contributions and public commits in your country, and your place in the world ranking. Gold, silver and bronze for the top 3, blue for everyone else.
badge.note: Replace {placeholder} with your login if you did not fill it in. A badge shows your rank once you are in that ranking (see {link}). If you are in another ranking, it reads "unranked" until then; if you are in none yet, shields.io shows it as not found. The link opens your country's ranking (or the world ranking) with your row highlighted.
